subtasks: Complete the equation by selecting the correct missing number or operator and placing it on the pad, then reset the robot arm.
Pick up the loose orange number 1 below the minus sign and place it on the empty wooden pad to the right of the equals sign.
Retract the left arm and use the right gripper to pick up the orange 1 immediately left of the orange 3. Place the 1 on the empty wooden pad to the right of the equals sign.
Return both robot arms to their episode-start poses with open grippers, leaving the completed equation in place.
